_meta.description: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

reason.description: An optional string describing the reason for the cancellation. This MAY be logged or presented to the user.

requestId.description:
The ID of the request to cancel.

This MUST correspond to the ID of a request previously issued in the same direction.
This MUST be provided for cancelling non-task requests.
This MUST NOT be used for cancelling tasks (use the `tasks/cancel` request instead).
